question: The Goa government launched a new scheme in November 2022 for which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dev Darshan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Goa government launched a new scheme named **Dev Darshan** in November 2022.
 
• This scheme is aimed at promoting religious tourism in the state.
 
• Under the **Dev Darshan** scheme, the government will facilitate visits to various temples and religious sites in Goa.
 
• The initiative is part of a broader effort to boost tourism and preserve the cultural heritage of Goa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Goa is renowned for its rich cultural history, which includes a blend of Indian and Portuguese influences.
 
• The state is a popular tourist destination, attracting visitors for its beaches, architecture, and religious sites.
 
• Efforts like the **Dev Darshan** scheme are aimed at diversifying the tourism offerings beyond beaches to include cultural and religious tourism.
